tools.name: get_product_info
tools.description: Describes SmartestVoice and its products. Topic "overview" summarises the company, products and industries; "voice_assistant" covers the AI voice assistant that answers phone calls; "chatbot" the website chatbot; "inventory_management" the AI inventory management. Greek examples: «τι είναι το Smarte

tools.name: list_business_types
tools.description: Lists the industries (κλάδοι) and every business type (επαγγέλματα) SmartestVoice has a dedicated page for, such as plumbers, physiotherapists, law firms, hair salons, restaurants and hotels, each with its id, for example "profession:plumber" or "industry:healthcare". Greek example: «για ποια επαγγέ

tools.name: get_business_type
tools.description: Explains how SmartestVoice works for one industry or business type: the calls it handles, the benefits, frequently asked questions and the page URL. The id has the form "profession:<key>" or "industry:<key>", for example "profession:plumber" or "industry:healthcare". Greek examples: «AI γραμματεία γ

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns the SmartestVoice plans with monthly and annual prices in euros, what each plan includes, the feature comparison and the optional add ons. Greek examples: «πόσο κοστίζει», «τιμές και πακέτα».

tools.name: estimate_missed_calls_cost
tools.description: Estimates the revenue a business loses to missed calls per week, month and year, from how many calls it misses each week and the average value of a call. tools.name: get_contact_options
tools.description: Returns how to reach SmartestVoice: the demo line to hear the voice assistant live, email, WhatsApp, Viber and the contact page. Greek examples: «θέλω να το δοκιμάσω», «επικοινωνία», «κλείστε demo».

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business_type, get_contact_options · Private data: get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business_type, get_contact_options · Private data: get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
